key_decisions.rationale: Retains the severe impossibility and first three experiences.
key_decisions.before: For it is impossible, in the case of people who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, and have shared in the Holy Spirit,
key_decisions.after: For it is impossible to restore again to repentance those who were once enlightened, tasted the heavenly gift, became partners in the Holy Spirit,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For it is impossible, in the case of those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, and have shared in the Holy Spirit,

key_decisions.before: and have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the age to come,
key_decisions.after: tasted God's good word and the powers of the coming age,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the age to come,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves apostasy, recrucifixion and public humiliation.
key_decisions.before: and then have fallen away, to restore them again to repentance, since they are crucifying once again the Son of God to their own harm and holding him up to contempt.
key_decisions.after: and then fell away, since they crucify God's Son again for themselves and expose him to public shame.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and then have fallen away, to restore them again to repentance, since they are crucifying once again the Son of God to their own harm and holding him up to contempt.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains failed crop, curse and fire.
key_decisions.before: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is worthless and near to being cursed, and its end is to be burned.
key_decisions.after: But land that produces thorns and thistles is worthless and near a curse; its end is burning.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is worthless and near to being cursed, and its end is to be burned.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains warning, imitation and twin means.
key_decisions.before: so that you may not be sluggish, but imitators of people who through trust and patience inherit the promises.
key_decisions.after: so that you do not become sluggish but imitate those who inherit the promises through faith and patience.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: so that you may not be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and patience inherit the promises.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves impossibility, refuge and gripping hope.
key_decisions.before: so that by two unchangeable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled for refuge might have strong encouragement to hold firmly to the hope set before us.
key_decisions.after: so that through two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled for refuge might have strong encouragement to seize the hope set before us.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: so that by two unchangeable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled for refuge might have strong encouragement to hold fast to the hope set before us.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps anchor and sanctuary imagery together.
key_decisions.before: We have this as a sure and steadfast anchor of the soul, a hope that enters into the inner place behind the curtain,
key_decisions.after: We have this hope as a secure and firm anchor for the soul, entering the inner place behind the curtain,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: We have this as a sure and steadfast anchor of the soul, a hope that enters into the inner place behind the curtain,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains forerunner, representation and eternal named priesthood.
key_decisions.before: where Jesus has gone as a forerunner on our behalf, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.
key_decisions.after: where Jesus entered ahead of us on our behalf, having become high priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek.
